name: Completed Course, Then a Different Course in a Future Academic Year
description:
SLD POSTs a learner onto ZSC00001 starting 2026-06-01 and already completing 2026-06-30, employer approves it. SLD then POSTs the same learner onto a different course, ZSC00002, starting 2027-09-01 with a one-month expected duration and no completion or withdrawal date — over a year later, in a later academic year, with no employer approval. Exercises a large temporal gap and an academic-year boundary crossing between a learner's two short courses with the same provider.

Currently learning does not have a concept of Academic Year, so "subsequent Academic Year" has no meaning beyond it resulting in a POST (if no learning was continuing) which appears to be fine, but the second POST (re-POST of the same payload) already removes the first learning, as the apparently absent OnProgrammes relating to the previous year are treated as omissions.

steps.name: SLD Creates Short Course 1 (ZSC00001), Already Complete
SLD Creates Short Course 2 (ZSC00002) for the Same Learner, Starting Sep 2027
SLD no-op PUTs Short Course 2 (ZSC00002) with the Same Payload
